[New]

📦 **FedEx like Home Assistant**: FedEx's own status codes (including returns and ready for pickup at a FedEx location), delivery window, **service, weight, dimensions** and status history. Your API key stays the same; the login token renews on its own.

🟢 **Budbee Box done right**: Budbee Boxes now work like Home Assistant — a parcel *delivered in the Box* is **ready for pickup**, *picked up* is **delivered** — with the ETA as delivery window, pickup deadline and sent/return parcels.

🛍️ **Homerr is now Vinted Go**: Sign in with e-mail + code and see all your Vinted Go parcels, incoming and sent, with **pickup point, pickup code** and item name.

🟡 **InPost UK is now InPost**: Track InPost numbers in the **United Kingdom, Poland, Italy, Portugal and Spain**, or connect your **InPost account** (Poland / Italy) to see your parcels with their **locker open code**.

🇧🇪 **bpost with My bpost**: Sign in to see all incoming and sent parcels, **stops until you**, delivery window in Belgian time and your **Mail Ahead letters** (new trigger *letter announced*). Barcodes with a postal code keep working without an account.

🟦 **Ampère (bol.com) like Home Assistant**: Status, delivery window and status history straight from Ampère's parcel page via the link in your bol.com e-mail. Automatic discovery from your bol.com account via the helper stays exactly as it was.

🧾 **More capabilities**: next delivery, out for delivery, ready for pickup, pickup point, pickup code, recently delivered, sent parcels and last event on all six devices — plus service/weight/dimensions (FedEx), item (Vinted Go) and letters (bpost).

⚡ **New Flow cards** on FedEx, Budbee, Vinted Go, InPost, bpost and Ampère: triggers for **new parcel, tracking event, out for delivery, ready for pickup, delivered, problem or returning** and **sent parcels**, conditions for **out for delivery, ready for pickup, a parcel has status…, parcel … is delivered** and **parcel … is being tracked**, and actions to **track a parcel, stop tracking** and **remove delivered parcels**. Existing cards keep working with **extra tokens**.

🧩 **All in the widgets**: FedEx, Budbee, Vinted Go, InPost, bpost and Ampère parcels show up in **MyParcel Pakketten** and **MyParcel Bezorging** with the right status and timeline.

[Fix]

🔁 **No more repeated triggers**: Triggers on these six devices now fire **once per change**, also after an app restart; existing parcels are recorded silently after updating.

📬 **Statuses recognised**: Out for delivery, ready for pickup (Budbee Box, InPost locker, bpost pickup point, Vinted Go point) and returns are now recognised with **each carrier's own status codes**.

🔐 **Sessions that expire**: Vinted Go, InPost, bpost and Ampère renew their login or session on their own instead of failing on every refresh.

🖼️ **PostNL Flow image with the right status**: A PostNL parcel Flow could send an image with the previous status (e.g. text “Zending is gesorteerd” with an image of “Pakket is ontvangen door PostNL”). Every PostNL parcel trigger now gets its **own image, drawn at the moment of the trigger** with the current status, delivery window and progress — each parcel its own image.

🗂️ **Delivered parcels stay visible**: A delivered parcel no longer disappears right after the next refresh (also for DHL); it stays for the number of days you set.

[Improvement]

⏱️ **Smart polling**: Every **15 minutes** when a delivery is near, every **45 minutes** otherwise, and quiet at night.

🔒 **Safer logins**: bpost and Vinted Go store login tokens instead of your password; the bpost password is only used once.

🧠 **Less data traffic**: Timelines and details are only fetched again when a parcel changes; delivered parcels are not polled again.

🌐 **No more “unavailable” on a hiccup**: A network hiccup shows a warning with the last known data instead of making the device unavailable.

🗑️ **Delivered parcels tidy up**: Delivered parcels are hidden after a configurable number of days.

🌟 Enjoy the improved MyParcel v0.3.5 App with FedEx, Budbee, Vinted Go, InPost, bpost and Ampère rebuilt, new Flow cards and every carrier in the MyParcel widgets.
